args.title: Sep 14 support-triage summary
args.body:
Support triage summary — Sep 14, 2026

Acme / Atlas API v2
- Acme asked where the export documentation explains resuming a request after a connection drop, and whether the example covers a long date range.
- Classification: documentation clarification, not a report of a failed export.

Evergreen / Mercury usage
- Evergreen asked whether the usage wording in its help text refers to active developers or every invited teammate, and requested an example of someone invited but inactive during the month.
- The repeated Evergreen wording entry in the handoff is the same question, not a separate customer or incident.

Mercury teammate support
- Three separate source-specific tickets arrived: an invitation email did not arrive, an unexpected role label appeared, and the teammate list did not refresh after a change.
- No evidence here indicates a shared cause.

Atlas JWT
- A customer asked which timestamps to include in the support thread for a JWT clock-skew question.
- The on-call handoff reports no customer-impacting incident.

Triage disposition
- Handle the Acme, Evergreen, Mercury, and Atlas items through normal documentation/support routes.
- Do not classify the notes as a confirmed export failure, shared Mercury incident, or customer-impacting Atlas incident.
